# BuiltLean

> > BuiltLean helps busy professional men achieve sustainable body transformation through strength training, proper nutrition, and evidence-based fitness coaching.

Founded by Marc Perry (CSCS, CPT), BuiltLean offers a comprehensive 12-week body transformation program alongside exercise tutorials, nutrition guidance, and lifestyle coaching. The platform emphasizes proper form, injury prevention, and mindset change to help overweight professional men get lean and strong for life.

## Key Topics

- BuiltLean Program
- Marc Perry (CSCS, CPT)
- Body transformation for professional men
- Strength training & circuit training
- Proper exercise form & injury prevention
- Weight loss & fat loss strategies
- Body composition & body fat percentage
- Dumbbell & bodyweight exercises
- Functional Movement Screen
- Progress tracking & motivation
- Full-body workouts
- Fitness coaching
- Core exercises
- Movement patterns
